narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms associated with low pressure moving along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of the Virginia Northern Neck and Middle Peninsula.
ev: Mount Holly Road (Route 626) was closed in both directions due to high water.
Flooded roadways were reported in the vicinity of Sharps Road and History Land Highway.
Road was flooded near the intersection of Northumberland Highway and Richmond Road.
Portions of River Road and History Land Highway were flooded in Lancaster county near Lively.
Flooding was reported on Mary Ball Road near Lancaster.
Portions of River Road between Mollusk and Ottoman were closed due to flooding.
Flooding was reported on Main Street in Mathews.
Flooding was reported on John Clayton Memorial Highway near Gloucester Courthouse.
Multiple locations were flooded on Courthouse Road in Lancaster.
